## Core Product Offerings
- **Raw Pure Honey**: Unprocessed Pure Forest Honey (₹399/500g retail; 30kg/50kg/300kg bulk drums) harvested in the Western Ghats.
- **Dehydrated Superfood Powders (80–100 Mesh)**: Natural Dates Powder (unrefined sweetener), Caffeine-Free Dates Coffee Powder, Nendran Banana Powder, Red Banana Powder, Beetroot Powder, Moringa Leaf Powder, and Sweet Potato Powder.
- **Wood Cold-Pressed Virgin Oils**: Virgin Coconut Oil, Sesame Oil, and Groundnut Oil extracted below 45°C via traditional Marachekku mills.
- **Wellness & Snacks**: Jumbo Fox Nut (Makhana), Moringa Capsules, Himalayan Pink Salt, and Organic Jaggery Powder.
